newsitem.title: USA: (RPT)DOW JONES TO STREAMLINE TELERES VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: (RPT)DOW JONES TO STREAMLINE TELERES VENTURE.

text.p: Dow Jones & Co said Monday it is "significantly streamlining" its Teleres joint venture with Dutch insurer Aegon NV's subsidiary Aegon USA Inc, laying off the majority of its 68 employees effective immediately.

Dow Jones said it is "conducting a strategic review of the joint venture's future." Teleres, which was formed in 1984, is an online provider of information and analytics for the commercial real estate market headquartered in Ohio.
